# relgap

> See everything between your pin and latest: merged, classified release notes with breaking changes first.

## Start

- [Getting started](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/getting-started): Install relgap, give it a GitHub token, read what changed between two kubectl versions, then check the pins of a repository.
- [Install](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/install): Install relgap from a release archive, with mise or with go install, verify the signature, and set up shell completion and man pages.

## Concepts

- [Network, privacy and tokens](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/concepts/network): Every host relgap sends requests to, the programs it runs, where the GitHub token goes, what the cache keeps and what --summarize sends to a model.

## Reference

- [Configuration](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/config): Every relgap config key with its type, default, environment variable and flag.
- [Environment variables](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/environment): The environment variables relgap reads, and the ones it passes to child processes.
- [Exit codes](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/exit-codes): What each relgap exit code means, and which commands return it.
- [Fail-on values](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/fail-on): The --fail-on values of each relgap command, which make it exit 3.
- [JSON schemas](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/schemas): The JSON schemas of relgap's config file and JSON output, with the URL each is served at.
- [MCP tools and prompts](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/mcp): The tools and prompts that relgap mcp serves, with their input schemas.
- [SARIF rules](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/sarif-rules): The SARIF rules relgap outdated and drift report to code scanning, with their levels and help text.
- [Supported tools](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/tools): The tools relgap's curated registry describes: aliases, repository, release-note sources, EOL product and OSV packages.
- [Registry entry schema](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/registry-schema): Every key of a relgap registry entry, its type, allowed values and the keys each source kind needs.
- [Registry snapshots](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/snapshots): The mise and aqua registry copies embedded in relgap: source commit, date and entry count.
- [Changelog](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/changelog): What changed in each relgap release, from release-please's CHANGELOG.md.

## CLI

- [relgap](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/): Release-notes digests and toolchain drift for the tools you pin
- [Global flags](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/global-flags): Flags that every relgap command accepts.
- [relgap cache](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/cache/): Inspect or clear the HTTP cache
- [relgap cache clear](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/cache/clear): Delete every cache entry
- [relgap cache info](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/cache/info): Show the cache directory, entry count, size and freshness
- [relgap cache prune](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/cache/prune): Delete entries not used for a while
- [relgap completion](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/completion): Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
- [relgap config](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/config/): Inspect and validate configuration
- [relgap config init](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/config/init): Write a commented config file
- [relgap config path](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/config/path): Print the config file locations relgap reads
- [relgap config show](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/config/show): Print the effective configuration
- [relgap config validate](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/config/validate): Validate config files against the schema
- [relgap digest](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/digest): Merge the release notes of every version in a range into one digest
- [relgap drift](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/drift): Show which repositories pin different versions of the same tool
- [relgap mcp](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/mcp): Serve digest, breaking_changes, outdated, drift and resolve to an MCP client over stdio
- [relgap notify](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/notify): Publish saved digest, outdated and drift reports as a GitHub pull request comment
- [relgap outdated](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/outdated): Compare every pinned tool version in a project with the latest release
- [relgap pins](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/pins): List the tool versions pinned in your repositories, with file and line
- [relgap registry](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/registry/): Check, test and update relgap registry entries
- [relgap registry lint](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/registry/lint): Validate registry entries against the schema
- [relgap registry test](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/registry/test): Run each source of a registry entry live and show what it produced
- [relgap registry update](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/registry/update): Download the newest registry entries from relgap's repository
- [relgap resolve](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/resolve): Show how a tool name resolves to a repository, version rules and changelog sources
- [relgap version](https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/cli/version): Print version and build information
